sidebar.item: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors

inputs.base: bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-zinc-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/50 focus:border-blue-500 transition-all placeholder:text-zinc-600

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-blue-500 transition-colors shadow-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-zinc-950

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must have visible hover states, typically lightening the background and slightly translating Y.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use `transition-all duration-200 ease-out` for most micro-interactions.
motion_and_interactions.chart_animations: Charts should have subtle entrance animations (e.g., stroke drawing or fading in up).

components_and_libraries.ui_components: shadcn/ui (Cards, Dialogs, Dropdowns, Tables, Tabs, Slider, Switch, Popover)
components_and_libraries.icons: lucide-react (Use strokeWidth={1.5} for a premium, delicate look)
components_and_libraries.charts: recharts (Customized with theme colors, no background grids, minimalist tooltips)
components_and_libraries.animations: framer-motion for page transitions and complex micro-interactions

auth_background.description: Black and white wavy lines abstract geometry, perfect for a subtle, premium auth page background

empty_state_texture.description: Dark clean UI pattern background, useful for empty states or subtle card backgrounds

abstract_architectural_texture.description: Dark abstract geometric architectural lines, ideal for hero sections or deep background textures.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Add `<link href="https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@800,500,700,400,900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">` and `<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">` to the root HTML file.
Implement a dark mode toggle in the Settings page, but default the app to dark mode.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Cabinet Grotesk is mandatory for a premium fintech feel.
Build a clean sidebar on the left. The sidebar should have minimal icons and a very muted active state.
The Dashboard must follow the 'Control Room Grid' protocol: dense, functional, and card-based. Use `gap-6` between widgets.
Cards must have subtle borders (`border-zinc-800` in dark mode) rather than heavy drop shadows.
For the 'Safe to Invest' popover, use a sleek shadcn/ui popover with a smooth framer-motion entrance.
The Spending by Category chart must use a minimalist Donut chart (Recharts) with the primary, success, and warning colors.
Ensure all interactive elements have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
Never use pure black or pure white; always use the tinted zinc palette for a cohesive, premium look.
Configure Tailwind with these exact font families so utility classes like `font-sans` apply Manrope and you can use a custom class for Cabinet Grotesk.
